target_customer: Developers and data or operations teams that need to get spreadsheet data into a database, later teams building internal tools
problem: Turning messy CSV and Excel files into a queryable SQL database was manual. Later the product became a prompt-based builder for back-office apps.
business_model: SaaS subscription for a hosted data import and database tool, later an AI app builder
product_category: Data import, then internal tools builder

founders.name: Jimmy Chan
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch calls the founders technical; YC page lists no education.

founders.name: Ayazhan Zhakhan
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in the August 2022 TechCrunch article; not on the YC page I read.

technical_complexity.rationale: Parsing and cleaning arbitrary files into a hosted Postgres database with validation is standard engineering with some hard edge cases.

defensibility.rationale: File import and spreadsheet-to-API tools were numerous and easy to copy; no data or integration lock-in was described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent absorbing the wedge. Later AI app builders and low-code internal tool vendors crowded the pivot space.

market_need_then: The founders found at YC that many people struggled to move CSV files into Postgres, which led to the product (TechCrunch, August 2022). No spend data found.

branding.name_origin: TechCrunch ties the name to the original drag-and-drop idea of dragging a CSV into a Postgres database; the founders did not state it as a formal naming story.
branding.domain_note: Used dropbase.io; the .com history was not found.
branding.community_and_virality: Open-source repo dropbasehq/dropbase and Product Hunt launches including Dropbase 2.0 and Dropbase AI exist; no evidence of merch or fan community.

brand_strength.rationale: Name resembles Dropbox, and searches returned no press about the brand itself.

pivots.from: Drag a CSV file into a Postgres database
pivots.to: Dropbase hosted data import and management platform
pivots.why: The founders saw others had the same problem during the W20 batch

pivots.to: Prompt-based AI app builder for back-office tools
pivots.why: Not stated; the YC page now describes the AI builder and the date is not given

outcome_analysis: Dropbase started in YC W20 as a way to drag CSV files into Postgres and raised a 1.75 million dollar pre-seed in August 2022 led by Gradient Ventures. It later repositioned as a prompt-based app builder for internal tools. The YC directory marks it inactive, but no shutdown notice or acquisition was found, so the cause is not public and failure factors stay empty.
notes: The round rests on TechCrunch (label pre-seed, Gradient lead) plus CB Insights and aggregators (label seed, extra investors from aggregators, one tracker totals 1.75M). dropbase.io did not resolve in this session so the site was not checked. No competitor source dated near early 2020 was found; Product Hunt and StackShare lists are undated. Ma search result was a wrong guess and was ignored.
